paragon.settings.help:
• Drag frame to move grid
• D-Pad ↑ ↓ ← → moves grid per click
• Use − + buttons to zoom
• Use ★ to make all frames golden
• Use ↺ to reset to default size/position
• Use 🔓 to unlock/lock grid

settings.field.advanced_options.automati: When item parsing fails, save a local screenshot and replayable TTS text under ~/.d4lf/captures/automatic. Nothing is uploaded and microphone audio is never recorded.
settings.field.advanced_options.disable_: If TTS is working for you but you are still receiving the warning, check this box to disable it.
settings.field.advanced_options.fast_vis: The top-left coordinates of the fast vision overlay in pixels. For example: (300, 500). Leave blank for the default position.
settings.field.advanced_options.force_re: Refresh the junk/favorite status of all items in your inventory and stash without running a filter afterward.
settings.field.advanced_options.info_ove: Hotkey to open or close the info panel overlay.
The minimum level written to logs.
settings.field.advanced_options.log_time: Include timestamps in Dashboard and Full Logs messages. Log files always include timestamps.
settings.field.advanced_options.move_to_: Hotkey to move configured items from inventory to stash.
Hotkey to move configured items from stash to inventory.
settings.field.advanced_options.process_: The process that is running Diablo IV. You should normally never change this.
settings.field.advanced_options.run_filt: Hotkey to run the filter. An item that matches no profile is marked as junk.
Hotkey to run the filter. An item that matches no profile is dropped.
Hotkey to force-refresh item status and run the filter. All junk/favorite marks are reset.
settings.field.advanced_options.run_visi: Hotkey to enable or disable Vision Mode.
settings.field.advanced_options.show_dia: Show the manual raw-TTS capture page in Settings. This does not enable automatic capture.
settings.field.advanced_options.technica: Include thread, level, logger name, and line number in Dashboard and Full Logs messages. Log files always include this information.
settings.field.advanced_options.toggle_p: Hotkey to open or close the Paragon overlay.
settings.field.advanced_options.vision_m: Only allow Vision Mode to run. All hotkeys and actions that click in the game are disabled.
settings.field.char.inventory.descriptio: Hotkey used to open the inventory in Diablo IV.
settings.field.char.inventory.title: Inventory Hotkey
settings.field.general.auto_use_temper_m: Automatically use found Temper Manuals while running the loot filter. This does not work while the stash is open.
settings.field.general.browser.descripti: Browser used to retrieve build data.
settings.field.general.browser.title: Browser
Stash tabs to check. Every available tab (6 or 7) must be unlocked.
settings.field.general.do_not_junk_ances: Do not mark Ancestral Legendary items as junk.
settings.field.general.full_dump.descrip: Generate a complete profile containing all filter items when importing a build.
settings.field.general.full_dump.title: Full Import
How to handle cosmetic upgrades that do not match any filter.
settings.field.general.handle_uniques.de: How to handle Uniques that match no profile. Mythics are always favorited. If matched-item favoriting is disabled, matching Uniques are not favorited.
settings.field.general.ignore_escalation: Ignore Escalation Sigils while filtering Sigils.
settings.field.general.keep_aspects.desc: How to handle Aspects that do not match a filter.
settings.field.general.language.descript: Switch both the D4LF interface and the Diablo IV item text/parser language.
settings.field.general.language.title: Interface and Game Language
Favorite items that match a profile.
settings.field.general.max_stash_tabs.de: Maximum number of available stash tabs.
settings.field.general.minimum_overlay_f: Minimum font size used by Vision Mode overlays.
settings.field.general.move_to_inv_item_: Item mark types moved from stash to inventory.
settings.field.general.move_to_stash_ite: Item mark types moved from inventory to stash.
settings.field.general.run_vision_mode_o: Start Vision Mode when D4LF starts.
settings.field.general.theme.title: Theme
